en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional European café or wine tavern. The room is filled with small round and square tables covered with white tablecloths, each with simple chairs and small flower vases. At the far end is a bar counter with shelves of bottles and glasses behind it, and a chandelier hanging from the ceiling. The walls are lined with coat hooks, framed pictures, and decorative plates. At the bottom of the image there is a caption identifying the place as Café Glück and referring to the Meißner Ratsweinprobierstube.
